meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 GitHub 上大量 issue 按根本原因分组，每个原因建一个「计划主 issue」和设计文档，关闭子 issue 并附固定引导评论，最后用一个 PR 一次性关闭整组。最终 open issues 与 open plans 一一对应。
howto.when: 当仓库有 20+ 个 open issue、很多像重复或同一缺陷的不同平台表现；或用户要求 triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe / group / make a plan from；或新 bug 需要路由到已有计划时触发。

say.text: 把这 20 个 issue 按根因聚类成几个计划主 issue。
新报的 bug #123 属于哪个已有计划？
把 plan-02 的修复打包成一个 PR 合并。
say.note: PR 里会列出 Closes #N，合并后自动关整组。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude clusters a GitHub backlog by root cause, creates one plan-master issue (plus design doc) per cluster, closes children with a standard redirect comment, and ships one PR that closes the whole group atomically. End state: open issues == open plans.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the repo has 20+ open issues, many looking like duplicates or platform-specific symptoms; when asked to triage/consolidate/cluster/dedupe/group/make a plan; or when a new bug needs routing into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster these 20 issues by root cause into plan masters.
say_en.note: Reads all bodies/comments, opens masters, closes children.

say_en.text: Does new bug #123 belong to an existing plan?
say_en.note: Matches symptom, posts a Round N comment, closes the child.

say_en.text: Bundle plan-02's fix into one PR and merge it.
say_en.note: PR lists Closes #N; merge auto-closes the whole cluster.
